description: Wave 1 — August 2026 supplier intake candidates selected for MKC registration. 40 identities spanning ELITE (6), ROSE (18), and SKYE (16) collections. Sourced from fragrance-list-2026-08.json supplier raw file. Dispositions and normalization corrections applied per EP-CAT-P2B and EP-CAT-P3A governance. UNISEX-56 supplier text is corrupted (PDF extraction boilerplate concatenation); canonical identity resolved by Founder clarification.

governance.note: supplierName values are exact from raw source file. Where the raw text is corrupted or abbreviated, the canonical identity is resolved in the paired research file.
